Disney’s The Lion King

Show Info

For over 200 years, the Lyceum has seen an array of spectacular performances and now, it’s home to the much loved Disney musical, The Lion King.

See your favourite story come to life on the Lyceum Theatre’s grand stage and immerse yourself in its thriving, vibrant atmosphere.

Grade II listed, the Lyceum promises a classic theatre experience that you’ll never forget. Book your tickets from the official site of the theatre.

Ticket Information
London’s West End

Disney's The Lion King

Find all the relevant ticket information for Disney's The Lion King in London’s West End from the official box office of the show. Read on for details about ticket prices, availability, group bookings and more.

Where can I purchase Disney's The Lion King tickets from?

Tickets to Disney's The Lion King can be purchased from the official box office for the best prices and deals.

How much are tickets to Disney's The Lion King?

Tickets to the show start from £33 plus booking fee from the official ATG box office. For further information on best value tickets please see our Disney's The Lion King seating guide.

What is the current booking period?

Disney's The Lion King is currently booking until 2027.

Please check the calendar for current performance information.

Are there limits to the number of tickets that can be purchased in one transaction?

You may purchase tickets for up to nine guests per transaction. For groups of 10+, please contact our groups booking team.

When will I receive my tickets?

Your tickets will be sent via email to the lead booker for the show. Please note that this is separate to your order confirmation email. Typically tickets are emailed immediately but please do allow 48 hours for it to arrive.
